We come to you

Your windows, your light,
your own home.

There is no showroom trip to arrange. Let us know your address, which rooms you are working on, and the best way to reach you.

Get a Free Consultation

  1. Arrange the visit

    Send your city and project details. We will confirm coverage and find a time for your in-home consultation.

  2. Compare and measure

    See samples at the windows where they will be used. We discuss privacy, glare, materials, controls, and your budget, then measure the openings.

  3. Order and install

    Review your selections and quote before ordering. Once the treatments arrive, we arrange installation and show you how to use them.

Questions about a visit

We can confirm the details for your address before scheduling.

Call (260) 222-6467
Do I need to visit a showroom?

No. We bring window treatment samples to your home so you can compare them with the room and its light. Tell us which products or rooms you have in mind when booking.

What if my home is outside the map?

Call or send us your address. The map is a general guide, and we’ll check whether we can visit your home before booking a time.

Can I ask about cleaning or repairs?

Yes. Contact us with the type of treatment and the issue. Repair and cleaning are separate services. Let us know which you need so we can discuss the work and a quote.

Let’s find a time to visit.

Tell David where you are and what you need help with. We will take it from there.
